description: This file defines a handler class 'AddClientAddressCommandHandler' that processes commands to add client addresses within the Fineract platform. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the address creation logic to the 'AddressWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: AddClientAddressCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles 'CREATE' commands for addresses associated with clients, by delegating to the AddressWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the create address command by calling the address write platform service to add a client address, passing client ID and entity ID extracted from the JSON command.
